description: This November, Tennesseans have an opportunity to put a strong taxpayer protection into our State Constitution. I encourage you to vote YES on Amendment 2 and prohibit Tennessee from imposing a state property tax. You work hard to own your home, build your business, or maintain your family’s farm. State government should respect that hard
